concept.title: Step 3: map and group, one dimension at a time
concept.shortdesc: Text about what is offered is grouped separately from text about who it is for, so each dimension gets a clean list.

conbody.p: This is the most important design choice.
If whole descriptions are placed on the map, the groups that form are a muddle:

ul.li: some gather around an audience, such as carers, with support groups, respite breaks and information pages all together
some gather around a provider, such as a dementia charity's café, choir and helpline
some gather around one council's house style

conbody.p: So the text about what is offered is mapped and grouped on its own. The text about who it is for is mapped and grouped separately. Each then yields a clean list for one dimension.

Care is taken that no single directory shapes the result. Open Sessions, for example, lists every weekly session separately, so one dance school appears 76 times. Its sessions are first collapsed into one entry for each service, and each directory contributes a balanced share.
